Game Overview

In Pitfall, the core idea is straightforward: navigate an invisible world using your unique ability to reveal hidden threats. Traverse treacherous landscapes and survive unseen alien adversaries. Harness your special powers to uncover obstacles and stay vigilant as you jump, dodge, and explore the mysterious void. Can you master the unseen dangers and triumph?

How to Play

Getting started in Pitfall doesn't take long to learn. Navigate an invisible world using your unique ability to reveal hidden threats. Traverse treacherous landscapes and survive unseen alien adversaries. Harness your special powers to uncover obstacles and stay vigilant as you jump, dodge, and explore the mysterious void. Can you master the unseen dangers and triumph?
